title: Haitian traditions of beings among us

tellings.quote: somebody just emailed me and told me about Traditions like that in Haiti you know and that you know he came to the United States and he could believe that we didn't have any belief in this at all when he would see things like that when he was there

plain: Haiti is said to have traditions about strange beings living among people, traditions so ordinary there that one man was surprised to find Americans had no such belief. Diana Pasulka, a religion scholar who studies UFO belief, tells Michels a man emailed her about it, saying he "could believe that we didn't have any belief in this at all" after the things he saw there. It suggests that what Americans call UFO encounters may be part of everyday religious life elsewhere.
